title: Get Array Elements Using Ranged Loop

blocks.content: Get Array Elements Using Ranged Loop
Create a program to get array elements using a ranged loop.

items: Create an integer array num of size 3.
Using a ranged for loop, get input for the num array.
Print the array elements using another ranged for loop.

blocks.content: Hint: Use the & operator with the data type to get the input.
